info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Ecommerce Cart Checkouts-v5-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Checkout Listing API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of checkout sessions for shopping carts within the ecommerce platform. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for developers looking to manage and analyze customer checkout activity. Typical consumers of this API include frontend applications, analytics tools, and inventory management systems that need to provide insights into checkout behaviors. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance user experience and optimize their sales funnels.

get.summary: Proceed to checkout the items in the cart.
get.description: This endpoint initiates the checkout process for the items currently in the user's shopping cart. It retrieves the necessary information to continue with the purchase and presents the user with options to complete their transaction.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for initiating the checkout process for the items currently in the cart. It should include the necessary information required for processing the checkout, such as user details, billing information, and any promotional codes applied.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsRequest.description: Represents the JSON request body for the checkout operations in the shopping cart API.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.title: Checkout Response

status.description: Indicates whether the checkout operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the checkout transaction.

resultId.description: Identifier of the result of the checkout process.

state.description: The current state of the checkout process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the checkout in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the checkout process.

ListEcommerceCartCheckoutsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the checkout operation, providing details about the status of the checkout process.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the transaction.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the transaction was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the transaction was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Contains metadata about the creation of the checkout transaction.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This value can help in identifying performance issues.
